name: jellyfin/user-home
title: Jellyfin User Home Overview
description: Read-only user home snapshot answering "what am I currently watching?" and "what should I watch next?": continue-watching resume items, next-up episodes, and recently added media. username is optional; when omitted the acting user is auto-resolved from active sessions, the profile default, or the single enabled user.

username.description: Jellyfin user whose home views are collected (optional; auto-resolved when omitted)
